judgment_text:
Prayer : appeal under Clause 15 of the letters patent seeking to set aside the impugned order dated 8-1-2026 passed in W.P. No. 14886 of 2025

The Judgment of the Court was delivered by

Manindra Mohan Shrivastava, C.J.:— Challenge to the order of the learned Single Judge is premised mainly on the submission that once the writ petition was filed and status quo order was passed by writ court, further proceedings and implementation of award could not be allowed.

2. It is not the case of appellant that after the status quo order was passed on 25-4-2025, award was passed.

3. From the records, it is clear that even prior to the passing of interim order of status quo on 5-4-2025, award was passed on 13-3-2025.

4. If that be so, the remedy of appellant lies in challenging the award by taking recourse to the proceedings known to law. That is what learned Single Judge has done. Therefore, reserving liberty, as has been granted by learned Single Judge, appeal is dismissed. There shall be no order as to costs. Consequently, the interim application is also dismissed.
